desc:
NEW MODE: Sandbox, do whatever you want!
NEW CONTENT: Modifiers to make the round more rewarding.

🌪️ Your truck is broken. An EF5 tornado is coming. You have 10 minutes.

Search an abandoned town with your crew, find the parts, and repair your truck before the tornado wipes out everything.

🔎 Search houses and garages for supplies.
🔧 Work together to haul parts and fix the truck.
🔦 Brave blackouts, flying debris, and smaller tornadoes.
🚚 Get everyone aboard before your ride leaves!

The storm gets worse every minute. Basements might save you from the smaller tornadoes, but nothing in town will survive the big one.

Once the truck is repaired, you have 45 seconds to get inside.

Don't get left behind.

Fully supported for computers 🖥️, phones 📱, and consoles 🎮!
This game is inspired by Funnel Runners. Please support the original game if you can!
